email.subject: AI for Olshan Frome Wolosky - built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi there,

Olshan's #1 ranked Shareholder Activism practice handles some of the most complex, high-stakes work in corporate law. That kind of sophisticated deal work demands precision and efficiency at scale.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of independent practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now meeting regional firms to show how-as ex-lawyers ourselves-we're helping sophisticated practices compete with BigLaw on capability, not headcount.

Worth 20 minutes to explore?

Vasu
Lucio
